name: Matriarch Lladi Telvanni
location: Bal Sunnar — Excavation Chamber (past), Peryitic Ritual Chamber (future)

abilities.name: Poisonous Bolt
abilities.description: A basic ranged attack dealing moderate poison damage.

abilities.name: Toxic Eruption
abilities.description: Matriarch Lladi Telvanni slams her staff into the water, causing poisoned water to bubble over and explode at your location, indicated by a growing circular AoE, dealing high poison damage.

abilities.name: Plague Bomb
abilities.description: Matriarch Lladi Telvanni charges her staff before throwing an orb of concentrated poison at you which explodes on impact, dealing massive poison damage. This attack can be blocked.

abilities.name: Infectious Vomit
abilities.description: Matriarch Lladi Telvanni rears back before starting to belch large amounts of toxic vomit in front of her, indicated by a wide conical AoE, dealing very high poison damage. She will adjust her positioning if you attempt to strafe.

abilities.name: Plague Dash
abilities.description: Matriarch Lladi Telvanni dashes forward to one of the far ends of the arena, leaving lingering plague clouds in her wake, all indicated by circular AoEs, dealing high physical damage on impact and high poison damage if standing in the affected areas.

abilities.name: Summon Voriplasm
abilities.description: Occasionally, Matriarch Lladi Telvanni throws a blob of slime down into the arena, which forms into a Peryite's Glory that comes in to assist her.

abilities.name: Toxic Storm
abilities.description: At 75% / 40% health, Matriarch Lladi Telvanni dashes to the center of the arena, becomes invulnerable to damage, and summons and arena-wide storm of toxic gas, dealing continuous moderate poison damage. During the storm, Peryite's Blessed will appear to attack you. The only way to make the storm cease is to collect three Shards of Time that appear in various separate locations within the arena by using the "​ Freeze Time" synergy.

dialogue.speaker: Matriarch Lladi Telvanni
dialogue.line: They've come for the artifact! Do not let them near it!
dialogue.trigger: While you hear the residents refer to her when you first enter in Bal Sunnar, you and Saresea don't meet her in person until you arrive in the settlement's past. The Matriarch is first encountered at the excavation site, where she believes you have come to steal what is rightfully theirs. She will direct her Telvanni to attack you

notes: She ages throughout the dungeon; in the past she has brown hair, while in the future she has white hair and wrinkles.
related_quests: Unstuck From Time: Investigate a temporal disturbance at the remote Telvanni settlement of Bal Sunnar.
Pledge: Bal Sunnar: Explore Bal Sunnar and return Undaunted.
summary: Matriarch Lladi Telvanni is a Dark Elf member of House Telvanni and founder of the settlement of Bal Sunnar in Stonefalls a few thousand years ago. She formed a group called the Blessed Inheritors and came to the area to locate and obtain what she referred to as "Their Inheritance". You unwittingly become her enemy when you become drawn into the time anomaly, which leads her to go to more extreme lengths to defeat you. She also functions as the final boss of this dungeon.
